observations.title: Chikurachki volcano (Russia)
observations.description: The Kamchatkan Volcanic Eruption Response Team (KVERT) reported that an explosive eruption at Chikurachki likely began at 1830 on 20 September based on satellite data and advisories issued by the Tokyo Volcanic Ash Advisory Center (VAAC). Ash plumes rose as high as 3 km (10,000 ft) a.s.l. and drifted 140 km NE and E. Explosions continued intermittently through the next day. The VAAC noted that during 20-21 September ash plumes rose to 2.7-4.6 km (9,000-15,000 ft) a.s.l. and drifted NE and E. At 1226 on 21 September the Aviation Color Code was raised to Orange (the second highest level on a four-color scale). Sources: Kamchatkan Volcanic Eruption Response Team (KVERT),Tokyo Volcanic Ash Advisory Center (VAAC)
